title: Chapter 496
text:
From Planet Golden Gate to Blue Star, the journey took two days. Even when they passed by Juberly Hub, Han Xiao did not pick up Mad Blade and the others personally. Instead, he sent a spaceship under his command to pick them up and return to Blue Star in the shortest time possible.

The forums that he had not logged in for a long time were opened again. He was very clear about the movements of the players. When the spaceship arrived at the atmosphere of Blue Star, the players happened to post the video of the large scale riot in Sanctuary Three on the forums. The players were suddenly in a predicament, but this was good news. Han Technician realized that this was an opportunity. After leaving Blue Star for so many years, it was best to make a memorable appearance when he returned. Therefore, he decisively led all the mercenaries to land. This was the standard landing mode for mercenaries.

During Version 1.0, he had left behind the name 'Black Phantom' in Blue Star, and he was famous all over the world. Of course, he could not return at night. This was not because he wanted to be high-profile, but because doing so would be very beneficial for his upcoming plan.

A stunning return would not only fulfill the 'promise' that he had left behind when he left the planet, but it would also show that he was closely related to the storyline of Version 2.0 and make the players excited. This was a way to create his own image. Since he wanted to attract the players to his faction, other than the benefits provided by his own strength, his image was also very important, just like a company's brand. After the accumulation of experience in Version 1.0, he knew that he had an innate advantage of having acquaintances among the players.

The most important thing was that … …

After all, acting cool did not cost money!

Looking at the shocked and overjoyed expressions of Bennett and the surrounding players, Han Xiao was very satisfied that his plan had worked.

"You …" Bennett opened his mouth but did not know what to say at that moment.

"We'll talk later. Let's deal with the matters here first."

"Okay." Bennett had a stomach full of questions, but he could only hold them back for now. He was very curious about what Han Xiao had encountered in the galaxy. He had not seen Pork Bun's video.

"Don't worry, I've dealt with this situation too many times. Leave it to me." Han Xiao patted Bennett's shoulder and smiled. "I'm a professional now."

As for the Beast Calamity, he had dealt with at least six or seven similar incidents. The Sunil incident had left a deep impression on him, so he had plenty of experience.

Han Xiao understood the situation at a glance. As long as the horde was dealt with, he would have time to knock out the refugees. The problem was that the players couldn't stop the horde, but to the mercenaries under his command, this was a piece of cake.

In the past, when he wasn't strong enough, he felt that the Blue Star wild beasts were very dangerous. However, after being in the interstellar space for so long, his horizons had broadened. From his current perspective, the Blue Star wild beasts weren't much. His strength was enough to sweep across the entire world and sweep through the Novice Village.

The Black Star Mercenaries unleashed all of their skills. Hundreds of light cannons pierced through the horde of beasts, and fireballs bombarded the ground like missiles. The majestic attacks sliced apart the beasts one by one, and the rumbling sound shook the earth, even suppressing the howls of the beasts.

Hu, hu, hu —

Herlous swung the ten-meter-long Battleship Slicing Blade like the wind. It was as if he was in a no-man's land. Any beast that came within a few dozen meters of him would be cut in half without any resistance.

Swoosh!

The rhythm of Sehrinde's legs brought out more than ten afterimages. His daggers were smeared with darkness, and they swept past the beasts like snakes, leaving shallow wounds on their skin. However, his martial arts techniques had already penetrated the hearts of the beasts. Although it was only a shallow cut, the piercing blade wave had already pierced through the beasts' flesh, leaving a cut in their bodies. There was massive internal bleeding, but the wounds couldn't be seen from the outside.

Any beast that was cut by him would fall to the ground in the next moment. His attacks were gentle without any killing intent, but they were extremely cruel.

Bang bang bang!

The cannons buzzed, and Ginette was like an unfurled fortress. Guns extended from all over her body, and a total of twenty to thirty cannons shot out a dense rain of cannons, shattering everything in front of her. She was so excited that her face was flushed red.

Every time she fired a cannon, the pleasure was no less than copulation to her.

"Roar!"

On the other side, Harmon let out a roar, and his entire body suddenly swelled. His muscles expanded like a sponge, and his originally dense hair was squeezed out by his muscles. His entire body was covered with veins, and he was like a small giant draped in a beast fur battle robe. His body was even larger than this group of beasts, and these elephant-like savage beasts were like large dogs in front of him.

He held a door-sized black stone battle axe in his hand, and took turns to unleash violent attacks. Chopping, slashing, smashing, and slapping, he fought like a warrior, and very quickly, his entire body was bathed in blood.

Bang bang bang!

Beasts were sent flying by his attacks, and they landed heavily on the ground, just like a truck rampaging through a crowd of people.

Harmon's combat techniques were extremely proficient. His movements were violent and barbaric, yet there was an indescribable sense of beauty, a combination of strength and beauty. With his special ability to strengthen his body and his warrior subclass, he could be considered a different kind of martial artist, one that was even more savage and brutal.

The numerous players did not have the space to interfere, and they hurriedly recorded the battle. Watching the battle made their blood boil, and their excitement soared. The battle prowess of these B-rank officers far surpassed Blue Star's standard, and it was as if they were watching a movie. Black Star's sudden arrival gave them a great surprise. The appearance of the orbital airdrop pod was too flashy, and it was simply like a heavenly justice descending from the heavens!

Han Xiao took a careful look, and confirmed that there was no need for him to personally take action. With his current battle prowess, he could create an even greater impact on the players' hearts. However, after pondering for a moment, he finally gave up on this idea. It was better to leave some space for the players to imagine, and maintain a sense of mystery. Only then could his acting skills break through the heavens.

The originally thorny situation was quickly and efficiently resolved by Black Star's mercenaries. The beasts were completely wiped out, and they could be made into jerky and stored, alleviating the problem of food. Without the berserk beast horde, the hundreds of thousands of players quickly subdued all the sick refugees. After a quick count, less than a hundred thousand people had died, which was much better than the worst outcome … at least from the numbers, it was so.

However, looking at the pile of refugees' corpses, Bennett's mood was not good.

…

The outside of the sanctuary was a mess. Bennett temporarily left Han Xiao behind and commanded the sanctuary soldiers to clean up the battlefield. Han Xiao quite admired this kind of attitude of putting proper business first.

The sudden mission was completed, and the reward was over a hundred thousand. The lost progress was made up for. Tens of thousands of players swarmed forward and surrounded Han Xiao and the others excitedly. Ever since Han Xiao left, only the group of pro players could enjoy his interactions. They were so envious. Now that Black Star had finally returned to the embrace of the players, they could not wait to go up and touch him.

The players were not unfamiliar with the Black Star Mercenary. After all, Pork Bun's series of videos had a lot of viewers. However, the mercenary group at this time was obviously different from the last video of Pork Bun before the update. No one knew what happened during the update, but the Black Star Mercenary had many new officers. The players only recognized a few of them, such as Herlous and Aroshia. They could not help but curiously size up the other mercenaries.

"These people's armor is so cool."

"So many Sunils. Are they all working for Black Star now?"

"Wow, that girl is so young and so pretty. I'll give her 9.5 points." A player with unique eyesight noticed Sylvia.

"So many furry monsters …" Some players wanted to complain about the Luhan Beastmen, who were obviously much taller than the others. However, Harmon looked over with a strange gaze, as if there was desire and passion. This player's butt tightened, and his scalp went numb. He hurriedly hid in the crowd.

In reality, the first thing that Harmon would think of when he saw anyone was to pull them into his War League. Therefore, it was normal for him to feel thirsty when he saw people.

Many mercenaries were ugly, so in comparison, the presence of handsome men and beautiful women was much stronger. For example, Fu Ding attracted the attention of almost half of the female players.

"That guy is so handsome …"

Fu Ding felt the gazes of the female players. He looked back and politely gave them a warm smile. In the eyes of these female players, the world seemed to have brightened up, and their hearts were instantly intoxicated.

"Oh my god, so handsome that it's inhumane!"

"I … I think I'm going to fall in love."

"This old man's maiden heart is about to explode!"

Han Xiao glanced at them. He always felt that these female players had hearts popping out of their heads like bubbles. He did not expect that Fu Ding would have such an effect.

Most female players were more emotional, and their values were different from male players. Between practicality and appearance, they preferred the latter. Fu Ding was simply a harvester for female players.

Letting Fu Ding attract female players is beneficial to the faction's attractiveness. Bringing him along was indeed the right choice … Han Xiao nodded. He suddenly felt like he was a brothel keeper, and Fu Ding was one of his subordinates.

He usually did not think too much, but when he saw the players, he was also happy. They were all walking wallets!

Although the female players all looked at Fu Ding, Han Xiao did not have any opinion. As long as it was beneficial to the plan, he would not waver in his charm.

Because Pork Bun's "Black Star" video series was like a series, the Blue Star players were very interested in the development of the Black Star Mercenary. They could not wait to know the story of these new officers.

At the same time, the mercenaries were also observing the players.

Sylvia whispered, "Why are the people from my teacher's hometown looking at us strangely? Do you guys have the same feeling?"

"No, isn't it normal?" Fu Ding said.

The players that surrounded them opened up a path. They walked past the hundreds of airdrop pods embedded in the ground and entered the door.

After entering the sanctuary, Han Xiao looked around and sighed. "Everything here has not changed since I left. I really miss it … Wait, why is there such an ugly statue here? Who is this statue? Why is it in my sanctuary? Huang Yu, Huang Yu! Come out and explain it to me! "

Not far away from the entrance of the sanctuary was a tall statue of a person. Everyone who walked in could see it. Han Xiao noticed it immediately and felt a little uncomfortable. This was his sanctuary. What was the meaning of putting someone else's statue here? Furthermore, it was such an ugly statue.

Huang Yu followed with sweat all over his forehead. Although he was now the actual manager of the sanctuary, in front of Han Xiao, he subconsciously reverted to his assistant attitude and spoke carefully.

"Your Excellency Black Phantom … That is your statue. You haven't been back for too long, so I asked someone to remember you."

"… Actually, it's quite pretty." Han Xiao changed his words as fast as a typhoon.

The group of mercenaries looked at the statue and then looked at Han Xiao. They all shook their heads. What? This statue does not look like Black Star at all. This statue is obviously a normal human. Even our leader does not know what species it is.

"Teacher, are you very famous in your hometown?" Sylvia asked curiously.

At this time, Bennett finally had time to walk over. He shook his head and said, "Black Phantom is not just famous. He is the legend of this planet."

The mercenaries looked at each other. Legend? They were a little curious about their leader's past.

"Black Phantom?" Sylvia opened her eyes wide and turned to look at Han Xiao. "So your nickname has always been so bad. I thought it was an exception."

"… Are you complaining that I have been too lenient with you recently? If you want to copy theory books, just tell me. I can let you live a very fulfilling year."

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. He pinched Sylvia's smooth face and pulled hard. It was so painful that she gasped.

Although they were chatting, he did not forget about the important matter. He turned to Bennett and asked, "What's the situation now?"

"The disaster you mentioned really happened. Sigh, let's go to the meeting room and talk more." Bennett could not help but look at Han Xiao. He wanted to say something but stopped. He asked, "Right, how did you come back?"

Han Xiao suddenly realized something. "You reminded me. I forgot something. Wait for me."

He took out his communicator and pressed a few buttons.

Rumble —

The wind pressure suddenly came, blowing the dust and sand into the air.

Shadows appeared on the ground, and then the shadows quickly expanded. More than half of the sanctuary was covered in shadows.

More than ten spaceships floated above the sanctuary. Their huge bodies covered the sky and the sun. It was a spectacular sight.

This was the fleet that Han Xiao brought. He did not want to stop in outer space, so he called the spaceships down and stopped above the sanctuary. They covered the sky and the sun!

This scene was thousands of times bigger than the airborne cabin!

The hundreds of thousands of players on the ground looked up. Their mouths were wide open, and they were stunned.
